🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive → Sector Weakness. Confirmation: weak overall breadth plus narrow leadership (Top 5: Narrow (4/5 Technology)) and visible major divergences across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, MA) — monitor for trend breaks.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Energy lead: MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +9.77% | 1M: +13.79%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +1.70% | 1M: +5.83%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing pockets of strength: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND. Communication modestly positive on 1W flows but leadership narrow; SHOP (1W: +7.84% | 1M: +14.19%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials weak: CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, FCX (1W: -12.81% | 1M: -4.04%) BELOW TREND. Consumer Staples weak: EL (1W: -15.30% | 1M: -22.24%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND. Healthcare soft: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, PLTR (1W: +14.56% | 1M: +12.63%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +10.83% | 1M: -1.00%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND, MNST (1W: -11.36% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -11.73% | 1M: -11.10%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION — weakness concentrated in Materials and parts of Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Clear 1W momentum: INTU (1W: +17.64%), NOW (1W: +15.12%), PLTR (1W: +14.56%), MPC (1W: +11.64%), VLO (1W: +9.77%) — mostly cyclical/tech movers. Note MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY and MSFT (1W: +4.13% | 1M: -1.04%) RECOVERY as divergences among large caps.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed: pockets of strong gains but internal dispersion. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +8.08% | 1M: +1.40%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND versus ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND and AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION; sector leadership narrow and style mixed.

8. Financials Outlook?
Soft overall: JPM (1W: -3.60% | 1M: -8.76%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -0.87% | 1M: -3.62%) BELOW TREND, MA (1W: +0.99% | 1M: -5.63%) RECOVERY — downside across large banks/cards with limited pockets of recovery; sector not leading.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Under pressure with selective resilience: LLY (1W: -5.86% | 1M: -10.40%) BELOW TREND, UNH (1W: -2.32% | 1M: +3.83%) CORRECTION, JNJ (1W: -3.23% | 1M: +3.07%) CORRECTION — defensive names showing short-term pullbacks but not broad leadership.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to Energy cyclical strength (MPC, VLO, CVX) and high-conviction tech winners (INTU, NOW) while reducing exposure to structurally weak Materials/Staples names (CRH, EL). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak breadth; treat active positions as tactical and monitor for trend confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND, NOW (1W: +15.12% | 1M: +11.95%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: ASML (1W: -10.88% | 1M: -3.33%) BELOW TREND, CRH (1W: -11.00% | 1M: -13.15%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +3.17%) — pockets ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Materials and Consumer Staples showing clear weakness (Materials 1W: -6.92%, Staples 1W: -5.38%) — monitor for further distribution.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
INTU above near-term resistance after big gap (watch follow-through at prior swing highs). NVDA (1W: +0.36% | 1M: +2.08%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for hold of recent support. AMAT (1W: -12.77% | 1M: +9.26%) CORRECTION — watch for failed-bounce confirmation or resumption of correction.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
INTU (+65): strong Q2, dividend hike and Anthropic AI deal — price confirming with ABOVE TREND (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%). PFE (+70): China obesity nod and cancer wins — PFE (1W: -2.17% | 1M: +1.01%) CORRECTION — sentiment improving while price shows short-term pullback. ROST (+80): earnings beat and buyback — ROST not in top list for returns here; watch for follow-through.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PYPL (-70): lawsuits and CEO exit — PayPal not in detailed list but high negative sentiment and monitor for price weakness. AVGO (-50): downgrade vs bullish roadmap; AVGO not in detailed returns here but sentiment divergence flagged. F (-45): Ford recall — F (1W: -13.77% | 1M: -11.13%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed by steep price decline.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, style mixed / no clear leadership given narrow tech concentration and weak breadth. INTU (1W: +17.64% | 1M: +7.97%) ABOVE TREND and MPC (1W: +11.64% | 1M: +13.51%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: major divergences across large caps (MSFT, AMZN, MA) and clustered tech leadership amid 3/11 sector breadth warrants watching for trend breaks; sentiment-driven names (INTU, PFE) require confirmation.
